title.zh: ⚡️Farcaster被Network School收购，年内第二次易主
title.en: ⚡️Farcaster被Network School收购，年内第二次易主

current_state.zh: Network School, backed by Balaji Srinivasan, acquired Farcaster from Neynar — the platform's second ownership change this year — with plans to rebrand it as the 'Network State Protocol' and require users to accept or reject a new social contract that grants an on-chain access NFT.
